'''Haast Aath''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] who lived during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Biography==
Aath worked as a [[Slavery/Legends|slaver]] and was originally employed by the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Morgra]]. However, during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], he became a [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] of [[Riboga]], Morgra's rival. Aath was tasked with capturing slaves for Riboga's [[Spice/Legends|spice]] [[Mining/Legends|mining]] operation on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kemix]]. He captured large numbers of [[Tarasin]] from the planet Cularin, taking them to Kemix via a [[Aath's slave compound|compound]] the planet [[Tharados]]. On one such run, he captured a group of Tarasin with [[Droid/Legends|droid]]-controlled [[Starship/Legends|ships]] that he commanded from his personal [[Z-95 Headhunter/Legends|Z-95 Headhunter]], the ''[[Insanity Claws]]''. However, he was pursued by the [[Heroes of Cularin]], who prevented him from leaving the [[Star system/Legends|system]] with the Tarasin.<ref name="Counterstrike" />

==Behind the scenes==
In [[For Every Action: Counterstrike|''Counterstrike'']], if the heroes do not kill Aath when they encounter him on Cularin, then they later encounter him on Kemix.<ref name="Counterstrike" />
